intraday_rationale: EURUSD displays strong upward momentum, clearing session highs with persistent buying pressure as DXY trends lower. An existing open position is already in profit, confirming the directional thesis. Structuring the stop-loss beneath the recent 15m swing low consolidation provides a clear risk-defined entry targeting a 1:3 risk-reward profile.
learning_applied: Applied lessons from prior tight SL sweeps on XAUUSD by placing structural stops well outside immediate noise behind the 15m swing pivot, protecting against premature wick-outs.
